description: Arrange the Spark Declarative Pipelines quality pipeline steps in the correct order for clinical trial data validation.
instructions: Consider data quality enforcement levels: What comes first—the data or the rules? Which expectations just warn versus drop records versus fail the pipeline? Pattern: ingest raw → apply soft constraints → apply hard constraints → define output → capture failures.
hints: Start with the raw data ingestion table
Drop records with invalid non-critical fields
Fail the pipeline for critical field violations
Define the clean output table after expectations
Quarantine captures records that were dropped
learnings: Define expectations before data enters the pipeline
dp.expect() logs violations but allows data through
dp.expect_or_fail() stops the pipeline on violations
Quarantine tables capture rejected records for review
Import as: from pyspark import pipelines as dp
